U.note: Clean ring dial with tabs, working auto-advance and editable lengths, but Space is the only keyboard support, no live region, and tabs lack pressed state.

V.note: Thorough accessibility and a countdown that is accurate, but text-heavy and overbuilt with two-press reset confirmations (the scripted reset did not reset) and no phase switcher.

W.note: Polished ring timer with clear mode, state text, pressed tabs, keyboard shortcuts, live announcements, undo on reset, and a pause-before-next-phase flow on session end.

X.note: Big readable clock with phase-coloured background, pips and progress bar; solid correctness and a11y, though presets, persistence and clear-count with undo add bulk and skip from focus always goes to a short break.

Y.note: Compact and tidy dark card with working countdown, but skip from focus wrongly counts a pomodoro, and there is no keyboard beyond Space and no screen-reader support.

Z.note: Minimal and clear: mode tabs, huge time, progress bar, pause state in label, stops at 00:00 and offers the next phase on a button, with a timer role and live announcements; lacks keyboard shortcuts and skip.
